_about: The single source of catalog truth. `python -m seed.seed` loads this file into
whichever database DATABASE_URL points at; nothing is fetched at runtime.
Provenance, stated plainly so nobody mistakes this for scraped data:
- Titles, prices, ratings and rating counts are transcribed by hand from the
reference screenshots in amazon_screenshots/. Where the reference did not show
a field for an item (a price hidden behind a delivery promise, a rating cut off
at the edge of the grid), the value here is a plausible stand-in.
- Descriptions and key_info bullets are written by us in the style of the
reference. They are not Amazon's copy.
- Images are locally generated placeholders under app/static/products/. No
Amazon image is hotlinked or redistributed. Regenerate them with
price_cents is an integer count of cents. There are no float prices anywhere.
